desc:
🚨 NEW MAP AND CARS 🚨

REALISTIC COMBAT
Eastern Warfare is a realistic and intense military combat experience. In this game you can engage in immersive, tactical combat ranging from trench to urban warfare.

Get kills and capture objectives to earn XP and Credits to buy new weapons and gear with.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Invite your friends and fight together! Experience one of the most realistic and immersive war games on the platform.

CREDITS
Gear created by Emil
Buildings from Sonder & Caesar

📢 DISCLAIMER
This game is set in a fictional future and a fictional conflict.
It does not represent real-world events.
The experience fully complies with Roblox’s Terms of Service.
